payload.gloss: the act resolving divergence or incoherence by a write that restores the law: for divergence, one whole-state version superseding every head of the entity; for incoherence, ordinary writes to the entities involved, one at a time. A write is refused only when it introduces a violation, meaning one whose entities were not already bound together in a standing violation of the same law; a write that shrinks or leaves a violation standing is allowed, so every incoherence can be repaired one write at a time. Reconciliation belongs to the domain's authority (the architect for design and plans, anyone for notes), is an amendment, and never shares a record with an acceptance.
